description: Defines a template class for managing arrays of callback listeners, including registration, invocation, and clearing of callbacks.

classes.name: IntListenerArray
classes.description: A template class managing a list of callback functions with associated arguments, supporting registration and invocation.

methods.name: IntListenerArray
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the listener array by clearing existing callbacks.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the current listener count and clears callback and argument arrays.

methods.name: registerCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback with an associated argument.

methods.name: registerCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback without an argument.

methods.name: invokeJustArgCallbacks
methods.description: Invokes all registered callbacks with their stored arguments.
